questions.question: What was the gas consumption peak month for SME customers in 2013?
questions.evidence: Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
questions.SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 5, 2) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.fld002 = 'SME' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(T2.fld015) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.Segment = 'SME' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the average monthly consumption of customers in SME for the year 2013?
questions.evidence: Average Monthly fld015 = AVG(fld015) / 12; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.fld015) / 12 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.fld002 = 'SME'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(T2.Consumption) / 12 FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' AND T1.Segment = 'SME'

questions.question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
questions.evidence: annual average consumption of customer with the lowest fld015 in each fld002 = total consumption per year / the number of customer with lowest fld015 in each segment; Difference in annual average = SME's annual average - LAM's annual average; Difference in annual average = LAM's annual average - KAM's annual average; Year 2013 can be presented as Between 201301 And 201312; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'SME', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'LAM', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'LAM', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'KAM', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'KAM', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'SME', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld003 = 'CZK' AND T2.fld015 = (SELECT MIN(fld015) FROM tab05) AND T2.fld010 BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Consumption = ( SELECT MIN(Consumption) FROM yearmonth ) AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312

questions.question: Which of the three segments—SME, LAM and KAM—has the biggest and lowest percentage increases in consumption paid in EUR between 2012 and 2013?
questions.evidence: Increase or Decrease = consumption for 2013 - consumption for 2012; Percentage of Increase = (Increase or Decrease / consumption for 2013) * 100%; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'SME' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2013%', T2.fld015, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'SME' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2012%', T2.fld015, 0))) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'SME' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2012%', T2.fld015, 0)), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'LAM' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2013%', T2.fld015, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'LAM' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2012%', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'LAM' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2012%', T2.fld015, 0)), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'KAM' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2013%', T2.fld015, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'KAM' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2012%', T2.fld015, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.fld002 = 'KAM' AND T2.fld010 LIKE '2012%', T2.fld015, 0)) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0))) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)), CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) , CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2013%', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM' AND T2.Date LIKE '2012%', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID

questions.question: Among the customers who paid in euro, how many of them have a monthly consumption of over 1000?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld003 = 'EUR' AND T1.fld015 > 1000.00
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Currency = 'EUR' AND T1.Consumption > 1000.00

questions.question: What is the highest monthly consumption in the year 2012?
questions.evidence: The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(fld015) FROM tab05 WHERE SUBSTRING(fld010, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(fld010, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(fld015) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY SUBSTR(Date, 5, 2) ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What segment did the customer have at 2012/8/23 21:20:00?
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld002 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld010 = '2012-08-23' AND T1.fld011 = '21:20:00'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-23' AND T1.time = '21:20:00'

questions.question: Please list the disparate time of the transactions taken place in the gas stations from chain no. 11.
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld011 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 WHERE T2.fld005 = 11
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Time FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.ChainID = 11

questions.question: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
questions.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld009) FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 WHERE T2.fld006 = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld010) >= '2012'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) >= '2012'

questions.question: Please list the product description of the products consumed in September, 2013.
questions.evidence: September 2013 refers to 201309; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.fld008 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T3 ON T1.fld007 = T3.fld007 WHERE T2.fld010 = '201309'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T3.Description FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID INNER JOIN products AS T3 ON T1.ProductID = T3.ProductID WHERE T2.Date = '201309'

questions.question: For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'; Consumption decrease rate = (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(fld010, 1, 4) = '2012', fld015, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(fld010, 1, 4) = '2013', fld015, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(fld010, 1, 4) = '2012', fld015, 0)) FROM tab05 WHERE fld001 = (SELECT T1.fld001 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 WHERE T1.fld010 = '2012-08-25' AND T1.fld014 = 1513.12)
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2012', Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2013', Consumption, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(SUBSTRING(Date, 1, 4) = '2012', Consumption, 0)) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = ( SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25' AND T1.Price  = 1513.12 )

questions.question: What's the nationality of the customer who spent 548.4 in 2012/8/24?
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld006 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 WHERE T1.fld010 = '2012-08-24' AND T1.fld014 = 548.4
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price  = 548.4

questions.question: What is the amount spent by customer "38508" at the gas stations? How much had the customer spent in January 2012?
questions.evidence: January 2012 refers to the Date value = '201201'
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(T1.fld014), SUM(IIF(T3.fld010 = '201201', T1.fld014, 0)) FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T3 ON T1.fld001 = T3.fld001 WHERE T1.fld001 = '38508'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(T1.Price ) , SUM(IIF(T3.Date = '201201', T1.Price, 0)) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.CustomerID = '38508'

questions.question: What is the percentage of the customers who used EUR in 2012/8/25?
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.fld003 = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld010 = '2012-08-25'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-25'

questions.question: For all the people who paid more than 29.00 per unit of product id No.5. Give their consumption status in the August of 2012.
questions.evidence: August of 2012 refers to the Date value = '201208' ; Price per unit of product = Price / Amount;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld015 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld014 / T1.fld013 > 29.00 AND T1.fld007 = 5 AND T2.fld010 = '201208'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Price / T1.Amount > 29.00 AND T1.ProductID = 5 AND T2.Date = '201208'
